channel.title: US Top News and Analysis
channel.description: CNBC is the world leader in business news and real-time financial market coverage. Find fast, actionable information.

item.title: Google's AI reshuffle: Chief scientist Jeff Dean exits and Demis Hassabis steps down as DeepMind CEO
item.description: Google's AI divisions are getting reshuffled, the search giant announced on Wednesday.

item.title: Iran, Oman say Strait of Hormuz talks in final stages, as Trump again teases a deal being close
item.description: Trump's latest remarks signaling again that a deal with Iran to reopen the Hormuz Strait is close at hand drove oil prices lower and sent stocks soaring.

item.title: Fed Governor Cook says she's 'prepared to act' on rate hike to address inflation
item.description: Cook was part of a 9-3 majority that voted last week to keep the central bank's benchmark borrowing rate in a range between 3.5%-3.75%.

item.title: Stocks making the biggest moves after hours: Sandisk, Western Digital, E.l.f. Beauty, AppLovin & more
item.description: Here are some of the companies making big moves in extended trading.

item.title: Stock futures inch higher after blue-chip Dow posts new record close: Live updates
item.description: Markets ended divided Wednesday as a record close in the Dow Industrials contrasted with losses in the Nasdaq Composite and S&P 500.

item.title: SpaceX ramps up Tesla Megapack purchases in Q2 to power its AI data centers
item.description: SpaceX is using Tesla's big Megapack backup batteries to help power its Colossus AI data centers in Greater Memphis.

item.title: Etsy laying off 12% of staff in bid to streamline business, position for growth

item.title: Marc Benioff gets a new operating chief, as Salesforce promotes Miguel Milano

item.title: Income investors should add global bonds, Invesco says. Where the firm is finding solid yields
item.description: The Invesco Flexible Income ETF has roughly 40% of its holdings in international bonds.

item.description: JPMorgan Chase CEO Jamie Dimon sits down with CNBC's Leslie Picker in Los Angeles to talk JPMorgan's partnership with the 2028 Olympics, his take on current market conditions, his thought on Federal Reserve Chairman Warsh, and more.

item.title: E.l.f. Beauty sees $50 million windfall in tariff refunds as profits surge 100%

item.title: We're increasing our Eli Lilly price target after another beat-and-raise quarter
